lines.en: I walk slowly, my body heavy.
My long neck sways side to side.
My tail drags along the ground.
One of my steps covers two of yours.

lines.zh: 我把背上的鞍晃了一下。
lines.en: My saddle rocks with each step.
I circle the pen.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在土上留下很深的印。
lines.en: My claws leave deep prints.
I stop and turn my head to you.
I lower my head and rub the ground.
I am far larger than the little Nillos.
Each step makes the ground tremble slightly.
I cross the grass slope and it lies flat.
I lower my head a little.
My soles are very broad.
I pause each step to listen.
I brush past the tree.
My saddle strap sounds once.
I stand with my neck raised.
My scales gleam in the light.
I curl my tail by my hind feet.
I wait for someone to ride me.
I rest my head on the fence.
My saddle is a bit loose.
I am watching the trees far off.
I flick the tip of my tail.
These scales can carry a rider.

lines.zh: 我把脚掌在土里按了按。
lines.en: I press my soles into the soil.
I tilt my long neck to one side.
My nostrils flare and close.
I lay my tail tip on the ground.
I watch for birds in the sky.
Are you going to ride me?
I lower my head and my nose touches you.
You are shorter than me.
I cannot wear armour.
Do you have raw chicken?
I bend my neck down.
Hold on before you climb up.
I've smelled your scent before.

lines.zh: 你的手可以摸我的脖子。
lines.en: You may touch my neck.
I ease back so I don't step on you.
I shake my head and the saddle rocks.
Which side will you climb up from?
I step back and the ground shakes.
My scales are cut.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，只是不痛快。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt; it's just unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴，草被扫倒一片。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a patch of grass flat.
I brace my four legs straight.
You hit my saddle.
I blow out a rough breath.
Heavy as I am, I still stand.

lines.zh: 我把头垂到你肩膀高度。
lines.en: I lower my head to your shoulder.
Is that raw chicken in your hand?
Hold it higher; I can't reach.
I lower my head to eat.
Do you have more?
I stride over on long legs.
Don't feed it all at once.
I have eaten plenty of this.
Don't pull back; my mouth is big.
I eat more than the little ones.
You may pat my head.
The smell on your hands is strong.
I slowly lower my head.
Don't shake; I might bite you.
I want another mouthful of roots.
Step back; I'll sniff it myself.
I'm heavy; a bump does that.
I crowd you aside.

lines.zh: 我这么大，撞一下你就翻。
lines.en: I am this big; one nudge flips you over.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，土被压出坑。
lines.en: I step back, denting the soil.

lines.zh: 我拖着的尾巴扫到你腿。
lines.en: My dragging tail sweeps your leg.
Two heavy bodies thud together.
You stepped on my broad sole.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，鼻子动了动。
lines.en: I look down at you, nose twitching.
Lean on me and I'll hold still.

lines.zh: 我是可以骑的大家伙，不是伴侣。
lines.en: I am a big ride, not a mate.
You should look among the herd.
My neck is too long.
Sitting against me is enough.
I rest my head on your shoulder.
My kind lives slowly.
Touch my chin.
I won't send you away.

lines.zh: 我把整个身子趴进草里。
lines.en: I settle my bulk into the grass.
I lower my head and take it up.
This can hang from the saddle.
I bite it; not very tasty.
Use that long neck to reach it.
I nudge it aside with my nose.
I carry it two steps.
My mouth is too big to pinch it.
Whose is this on the ground?
I carry it over and set it by your feet.
I sniff; nothing but soil.
I raise my head, neck taut.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把长身子转过来。
lines.en: I swing my long body around.
You're beside my tail.
I swing my tail.
Move; my feet don't stop quickly.
This is where I graze.
I lower my head at you.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，目光已经锁住你。
lines.en: My head lifts, and my eyes are already on you.

lines.zh: 我一脚能踩到你的脚印。
lines.en: One of my steps covers your print.
I push you toward the fence.
My tail keeps sweeping.
Have you counted my teeth?
I wait for you to run out of room.

lines.zh: 我的影子比你的大很多。
lines.en: My shadow is far bigger than yours.
Two more steps; I'm turning.

lines.zh: 别跑，我正一步一步跟着。
lines.en: Don't run—I'm following, step by step.
I butt with my head.

lines.zh: 这一下压上了我全身的重量。
lines.en: That carried all my weight.
My claw rakes you.
You're knocked onto your back.
I take my time; you can't outrun me.
Not heavy, but very solid.
I shove you against the fence.

lines.zh: 骑不上我，就别想躲开这一撞。
lines.en: If you can't ride me, you can't dodge this charge.
I walk out from behind the fence.
My saddle isn't fastened tight.
This grass would feed me half a day.
I stretch my neck to look.

lines.zh: 地面被我的脚压了一下。
lines.en: The ground gives under my foot.
I was just brought to this meadow.
I shake the soil off my scales.
I hear the little Nillos calling.
I fold my four legs and lie down.
It's wide enough to lie down.
I test the ground with a foot.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的鳞，我往后退。
lines.en: Fire catches my scales and I back off.

lines.zh: 摔下去，我的腿折了一下。
lines.en: I fell and my leg buckled.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的脖子，我往上挣。
lines.en: Water covers my neck and I struggle up.
The blast knocks me onto my side.

lines.zh: 一枚箭钉进我背上的厚皮。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the thick hide of my back.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我的鳞发麻。
lines.en: Violet light numbs my scales.
Too little grass; I am hungry.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我背上，我整条腿都软了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我往下沉。
lines.en: No ground underfoot; I sink.
